## Home Page (/)

### Hero

Streamline Your Invoicing Process

# Professional Invoicing made simple

Create, send, and track invoices with ease. Automated email reminders
ensure you get paid on time, every time.

Calls to action: "Start Free Trial" (sign in) and "View Pricing" (#pricing).

### Features

Everything you need to manage invoices — powerful features to help you
create, automate, and track invoices efficiently.

- **Quick Creation** — Create and send professional invoices in minutes with an intuitive editor.
- **Recurring Invoices** — Automate repeat billing by scheduling invoice templates that generate and send on your defined cadence.
- **Automated Email Reminders** — Never chase payments again — automated reminder emails go out on your schedule.
- **Client Management** — Organise clients with full contact details, multiple addresses, and complete invoice history.
- **Financial Reports** — Track revenue trends, outstanding balances, and payment patterns with exportable reports.
- **Invoice Analytics** — Get insights into your cash flow and invoice performance with clear visual charts.
- **PDF Generation** — Download polished PDF invoices instantly — perfect for sharing or your own records.
- **Secure Sharing** — Client-facing invoice links are signed so only the intended recipient can access them.
- **Real-time Updates** — Track payment status and invoice activity in real-time with instant notifications.

### Pricing

Simple Pricing — choose your plan. Start with our free tier and upgrade as
you grow. All plans include a 14-day free trial. Monthly and yearly billing
available (yearly at a discount).

**Free** — $0/mo — Perfect for freelancers just starting out
- 5 invoices per month
- 20 emails per month
- Client management
- PDF generation & secure sharing
- Automated invoice emails
- Basic invoice templates

**Starter** — $9/mo ($90/yr) — Great for growing businesses
- 25 invoices per month
- 50 emails per month
- Everything in Free
- Recurring invoices automation
- Financial reports & analytics
- Priority email support

**Pro** — $29/mo ($290/yr) — For established businesses (most popular)
- 100 invoices per month
- 500 emails per month
- Everything in Starter
- Advanced analytics
- Custom branding
- Team collaboration
- Basic API access
- Priority support

**Business** — Custom pricing — For large organizations
- Unlimited invoices
- Unlimited emails
- Everything in Pro
- Multi-user access
- Advanced API access
- Full custom branding
- Custom integrations
- Dedicated support
- SLA guarantee

Note: plan upgrade/downgrade requests are currently reviewed manually by an
administrator; the product does not yet process payment cards directly.

### Contact

Get in Touch — have questions? We're here to help you. Contact form fields:
first name, last name, email, message. Direct contact: hello@wemaad.net.
Address: 3, Makram Ebeid, Nasr City, Cairo Governorate, Egypt.

## Privacy Policy (/privacy)

See the full, current Privacy Policy at /privacy. Summary: WeMaAd collects
account information (email, name, address, company/bank details you choose
to display on invoices), content you create (client records, invoices,
recurring schedules), contact-form messages, and a single essential
session cookie — no third-party advertising or tracking cookies. Data is
used solely to operate the Service (creating/sending invoices, recurring
billing, authentication, abuse prevention) and is not sold. WeMaAd acts as
a data processor for client information you enter about your own
customers. Shared only with the infrastructure providers necessary to run
the Service (hosting, database, transactional email delivery).

## Terms of Service (/terms)

See the full, current Terms of Service at /terms. Summary: by using
WeMaAd Invoice you agree to use it lawfully, not attempt unauthorized
access to other accounts, and not abuse rate limits or send spam through
it. You own the client/invoice data you create; WeMaAd hosts and
transmits it on your behalf. WeMaAd Invoice does not process payments
directly (plan changes are manually reviewed) and is not a substitute for
professional accounting, tax, or legal advice — you are responsible for
the accuracy of every invoice you send. The Service is provided "as is"
without warranty; liability is limited as described in the full Terms.
Governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

---

## Technical

Built with Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma,
PostgreSQL (Neon). Authentication via passwordless magic link email
(Auth.js / NextAuth v5). Hosted on Vercel.
